title: 天皇賞（秋）の後に・到達

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Satono Diamond wins spectacularly. However, she says she'd like to race Mejiro McQueen in a long-distance race next time—Mejiro McQueen's specialty.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro McQueen suggests that the four of them, Tokai Teio and Kitasan Black included, all run in the Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After the race, Satono Diamond asks Mejiro McQueen what she thinks her role is as an illustrious runner.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro McQueen answers that it is to defeat strong opponents and prove the prestige of the Mejiro family.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Upon hearing this, Satono Diamond ponders what being an illustrious runner means to her.
